title: When Your Attitude Gets You Arrested
description:
An officer observed a black male whose appearance matched that of a robbery suspect. He tried to make contact with male to speak about the incident. Watch till the end for the full details about the charges. After a search of his bag, it was determined that he isn’t the suspect the cops were looking for. However, he was still charged with resisting an officer and suspicious incident.
